company.name: Cargomatic
company.shortDescription: Cargomatic is a platform for connecting local shippers and local truckers in real-time.
company.description: Cargomatic is a real-time on-demand network for Local Truck Availability. Shippers can submit loads and instantly find nearby trucks to service their needs. Since launching in early 2014, Cargomatic has aided the expedition of tens of thousands of deliveries throughout California, Chicago, and metropolitan New York.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,365,808 to $601,807,814, a 112.16x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 19 (-36 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
